title: Attio Launches New Hybrid CRM Architecture for AI Agent SQL Access
summary:
The software company has released a system that enables AI agents to treat customer records as a queryable database using SQL while upholding internal policies and permissions. This hybrid architecture allows agents to access data in a flexible syntax without bypassing the business logic, compliance rules, and security controls of the application. Attio developed the system to help go-to-market teams leverage autonomous agents across the entire customer lifecycle.

The update includes new data connectors and infrastructure capable of handling hundreds of millions of records. It also introduces a beta for "Activities," which incorporates product events and support tickets into the customer record to provide agents with additional operational context.

selectedTweets.text:
In the age of agents, systems of record have never mattered more. They’ve also never been less prepared for what’s coming.

Today, we’re announcing @attio's hybrid architecture, with the controls of application software at the scale of infrastructure.

To agents, Attio looks like a database, queryable in SQL - a language they're RL’d on. Unlike a database, the business logic, policies, and compliance sit behind the query.

This makes all of Attio’s data accessible by agents in the most powerful and flexible syntax. It gives GTM teams an order of magnitude more value from their time, with the full power of agents working across the entire customer lifecycle.

A new shape of software is here.

Attio's new hybrid architecture is one of the cleaner approaches I've seen.
